scripts.dev: bun run scenarios && bun run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: bunx concurrently -n party,web -c blue,green "partykit dev --port 1999" "next dev --port 3000"
scripts.start: bun run build && bunx concurrently -n party,web "partykit dev --port 1999" "bunx serve out -l 3000"
scripts.test: bun run scenarios && bun test tests/validate.test.ts tests/engine.test.ts tests/fuzz.test.ts tests/e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun run scenarios && bun test tests/validate.test.ts tests/engine.test.ts
